consequence.statement: Enabling the ValidateCAA feature gate still works in 1.17 but prints a warning; the gate will be removed in cert-manager 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Stop manually enabling the ValidateCAA feature gate.

original.statement: The ValidateCAA feature gate is deprecated in cert-manager 1.17 (enabling it prints a warning) and will be removed in 1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-6db6001fefb2] says the ValidateCAA feature gate is deprecated in 1.17, that enabling it only prints a warning, and that it is scheduled for removal in 1.18. [ev-09a9c9047035] says operators who enable it manually should stop. Neither source says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in 1.17, so deprecation (review) with low severity fits, and the remediation follows the upgrade guide.
